title: cardaminopsis halleri subsp. tatrica
intro: Cardaminopsis halleri subsp. tatrica, commonly known as Tatric Alpine Wintercress, is a subspecies of the Cardaminopsis halleri plant, which belongs to the mustard family and is native to the Tatric Alps. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Cardaminopsis halleri subsp. tatrica include its ability to reduce pain and fever, as well as its potential to treat gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
